state.rule: Artifact content is unavailable until a clean inspection. Only a malware quarantine can be released, by an attributed member decision after a clean rescan; secret-detected or invalid rejection is final. Downloads only for available content bound to the registered hash and length.

code_behavior.inspection_retry: A second RecordInspection with the same outcome and same instant as the committed inspection returns success with no event, even after a later quarantine release or download; a different outcome or instant returns StateConflict.
code_behavior.release_retry: ReleaseQuarantine repeated with the same request id, trimmed rationale, decider, rescan instant and decision instant after release returns success with no event, regardless of the revision supplied; any difference returns StateConflict.
code_behavior.inspection_time: An inspection instant that is default or earlier than the registration instant is refused with InvalidContent and appends nothing.
code_behavior.test_scenario: Test: release quarantine with request R, rationale 'Rescan clean', decider D; then repeat with (a) different rationale, (b) different request, (c) rescan instant one second later, (d) different decider D2. Expected: all four refused as StateConflict and no event appended.

inspection_retry_outcome.instructions: For state.code_behavior.inspection_retry, is the retry outcome consistent with the rule and standard exact-retry semantics?

criteria.noop_on_exact_retry: Exact retry of the committed fact is acknowledged without a new event and changed intent conflicts.
criteria.conflict_always: Any second inspection should conflict, including exact retry.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The rule does not decide this.

release_retry_outcome.instructions: For state.code_behavior.release_retry, is treating a stale revision on an exact committed retry as success with no event correct?

criteria.noop_ignoring_revision: An exact retry of a committed decision is a no-op regardless of the revision supplied.
criteria.conflict_on_stale_revision: A stale revision must conflict even for an exact retry.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The rule does not decide this.

release_test_asserts_invariant.instructions: The test in state.code_behavior.test_scenario proves that a committed quarantine release decision is immutable and that changed intent appends nothing.

inspection_time_premise.instructions: Refusing an inspection earlier than the artifact registration (state.code_behavior.inspection_time) is consistent with the rule that content is unavailable until a legitimate clean inspection.
